blackhole.skill.gravity_pull.desc: Manipulate gravitational gradients to yank target entities violently toward your focal point.
blackhole.skill.event_horizon.desc: Emit an intense personal gravitational aura: incoming hostile projectiles are forced downward into the ground, and enemies are slowed and crushed.
blackhole.skill.gravity_repulsion.desc: Invert gravity in an instantaneous shockwave, violently flinging all surrounding enemies into the air with heavy blunt force.
blackhole.skill.micro_singularity.desc: Fire a condensed vortex orb that continuously vacuums up nearby mobs and projectiles along its flight path before imploding.
Summon a celestial Black Hole with a spinning accretion disk. Sucks in all entities within 25 blocks and collapses into a devastating singularity explosion.
